section_summary.extract_value: This section reports a single participant sample (N = 646) comprising 199 men, 446 women, and 1 person identifying as other, with mean age M = 38.92 (SD = 11.71). The sample was majority White (92.4%); self-reported mean BMI was 27.25 (women 26.10, men 27.72). Educational attainment included 36.7% undergraduate and 15.6% postgraduate (college or higher = 52.3%); no survey method, country of data collection, BA assessment, or correlations between body appreciation and BMI are reported here.
section_summary.evidence_source: The sample (N = 646) consisted of 199 men and 446 women, and one person who described their sex as 'other.' The participants were aged between 18 and 76 years (M = 38.92, SD = 11.71). Self-reported BMI values ranged from 15.22 to 49.57 (M = 27.25, SD = 6.08). The majority of participants reported their ethnicity as White (92.4%; Asian or British Asian = 3.1%; Black or African Caribbean = 1.9%; other = 2.7%). 36.7% had an undergraduate degree, 15.6% had a postgraduate degree.
